conditions.ocrEngineNote: No OCR engine ran: labels are declared SIMULATED observations of the synthetic corpus.
conditions.claim: SIMULATED host evaluation only; no Android, emulator, device, OCR-engine, or performance claim.

noRegressionGate.criterion: inventory matched >= baseline matched AND inventory false positives <= baseline false positives, per the whole corpus

signature.absence: No detector cue produces `signature_area` on this corpus, so no signature ground truth is declared and no signature recall is claimed; signature typing is covered only by the recognition unit tests (field_inventory_test.dart, type_inference_test.dart).

unknown.absence: Every detected region carries at least one kind cue, so no region falls through to `unknown`; no unknown ground truth is declared and unknown typing is covered only by the recognition unit tests.

memory.note: host diagnostics only, no performance claim, excluded from the golden snapshot; processInfoMaxRss is the dart:io value in bytes and agrees with the kernel peak on this host
memory.unit: linux kernel per-process status counters VmHWM and VmRSS (kibibytes)

pages.description: Three labelled text fields, two checkboxes, a decorative frame, and a rule inside the print margin.
Betrag, Summe, IBAN, Steuernummer (number), PLZ, Telefon, Kundennummer (text), and a German date mask.
Four adjacent 11 pt checkboxes with 1 pt gaps.
Three drawn checkboxes against four declared ground-truth boxes: the missing one must be reported, never absorbed by a count.
A checkbox inside a second border 1 pt larger: one logical field, two geometric candidates.
A 2 x 3 grid: five empty cells are fields, one printed cell is not, and a marked checkbox is a filled region.
Decorative frame, margin rules, and empty whitespace only. The declared ground truth has zero fields.
Faint printing (ink 170 on 255 paper) on an otherwise clean form. The fixed 128 ink threshold cannot see it; the deferred contrast variant is NOT_RUN.
A bordered field whose bottom rule has a 4 pt gap. The box is not closed, so the lower rules and the bounded whitespace are the remaining evidence.
A vertical shadow gradient (155-215) behind one checkbox and one underline. Geometry must survive the photometric degradation.
Negative amount, percentage, a zero-padded number kept as text, and a label carrying both a date and an amount keyword.
Five single-line fields that fix the single-line reference height and one tall bounded area: the tall area must be typed multiline, not text and not a table.

timings.note: host VM measurements, diagnostics only, never a performance claim; excluded from the golden snapshot

snapshot.note: Canonical golden snapshot: no generatedAt, no timings, no memory, no paths. It freezes the per-page/per-field projection (rects, kinds, labels, cue sets, per-page candidates, section grouping) and the fixture/corpus/ground-truth identity. Byte equality with tools/evaluation/goldens/field-inventory-baseline.v1.json is the regression check.

noRegressionGate.criterion: inventory matched >= baseline matched AND inventory false positives <= baseline false positives, per the whole corpus

signature.absence: No detector cue produces `signature_area` on this corpus, so no signature ground truth is declared and no signature recall is claimed; signature typing is covered only by the recognition unit tests (field_inventory_test.dart, type_inference_test.dart).

unknown.absence: Every detected region carries at least one kind cue, so no region falls through to `unknown`; no unknown ground truth is declared and unknown typing is covered only by the recognition unit tests.
